fields.name: Event
fields.evidence: DispatcherSystem::Update destroys a FixedString at element+0x10 (stride 0x20, IndexedStorage<ecl::sound::PostEventRequest>) and fills it with FixedString::Create of the event name; DistantSoundSystem copies DistantSoundInfo.InitSound into it.

fields.name: field_14
fields.evidence: DispatcherSystem writes 3, DistantSoundSystem writes 0 (an event type or flags).

fields.name: Callback
fields.evidence: DispatcherSystem stores a pooled ls::SoundCallback object (vtable PTR_FUN_181580ff0) here; DistantSoundSystem stores 0.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: ecl::sound::DistantSoundSystem::ProcessSoundsActivated (EoCClient.dll+0xE81A40, parameter typed DistantSoundPostEventRequestSingletonComponent&) appends elements of stride 0x20: {entity handle, 0, init sound FixedString at +0x10, 0 at +0x14, 0 at +0x18} - the same layout as ecl::sound::PostEventRequest of the dispatcher.

open_questions: Meaning of field_14 (0 here, 3 from the dispatcher and the photo-mode writer); the element is ecl::sound::PostEventRequest, the same layout as Coverage.h ClientSoundPostEventRequest (renamed here because struct names must be unique to the component).
